lines.zh: 我用鳞足贴住岩壁，一寸一寸挪。
lines.en: My scaled foot grips the rock and I inch along.

lines.zh: 热液在下面冒，我沿着裂缝慢慢走。
lines.en: Vent water rises below; I follow the crack slowly.

lines.zh: 每一步都要粘牢，掉下去就完了。
lines.en: Each step must stick, or I fall into the dark.

lines.zh: 我爬过黑色的烟囱石，留下浅痕。
lines.en: I cross the black chimney stone, leaving a faint mark.

lines.zh: 水温变烫了，我换到凉一点的那侧。
lines.en: The water turns hot, so I shift to the cooler side.

lines.zh: 鳞片摩擦岩石，发出细小的沙声。
lines.en: My scales scrape the stone with a small sandy sound.

lines.zh: 我背着壳底下的铁色，慢慢往上游。
lines.en: I carry that iron tint beneath me, creeping upward.

lines.zh: 一群小虾让路，我继续贴地前行。
lines.en: A shoal of shrimp parts; I keep crawling along the floor.

lines.zh: 这里硫味太重，我掉头找下一个喷口。
lines.en: Sulfur is too thick here; I turn toward the next vent.

lines.zh: 前面有块新落的碎石，我绕了过去。
lines.en: Fresh rubble fell ahead, so I crawl around it.

lines.zh: 我顺着热流爬，那里总有吃的。
lines.en: I climb with the warm current; food gathers there.

lines.zh: 喷口喷了一下，我被推得滑开半寸。
lines.en: The vent spits, and I slide back half an inch.

lines.zh: 越往深处越暗，我靠水压认路。
lines.en: Deeper, it goes dark; I read the water pressure.

lines.zh: 慢是慢，可我从没被水冲走过。
lines.en: Slow as I am, the current has never taken me.

lines.zh: 我沿着喷口的圆石绕了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half way round the vent's round stones.

lines.zh: 壳里进了点沙，我边走边晃。
lines.en: Sand got in my shell; I sway as I go.

lines.zh: 我跟着一群小蟹爬过砂坡。
lines.en: I follow a line of little crabs over the sand slope.

lines.zh: 前面那块岩面滑，我多粘了一下。
lines.en: That rock face is slick, so I cling a moment longer.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只让鳞足露在外面。
lines.en: I pull in, leaving only the scaled foot showing.

lines.zh: 热水从壳边流过，我懒得动。
lines.en: Hot water slides past my shell, and I do not bother.

lines.zh: 铁味从石头里渗出来，我闻了很久。
lines.en: Iron seeps from the stone; I smell it for a while.

lines.zh: 我就这么贴着，像块会呼吸的石头。
lines.en: I cling here like a stone that happens to breathe.

lines.zh: 一只端足类爬过我背上，我没赶它。
lines.en: An amphipod crosses my back and I let it.

lines.zh: 喷口的烟在我上方散开，像一层灰纱。
lines.en: Vent smoke spreads above me like a grey veil.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得更扁，省点力气。
lines.en: I flatten myself further to save the effort.

lines.zh: 水底安静，只听见我自己磨鳞的声。
lines.en: The floor is quiet; I hear only my own scales.

lines.zh: 壳上落了层矿物，我懒得清理。
lines.en: Minerals settle on my shell and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我张了张触角，又收回去。
lines.en: I extend my feelers, then draw them back in.

lines.zh: 这块玄武岩是暖的，我打算再待一会。
lines.en: This basalt is warm; I plan to stay a while.

lines.zh: 一群鱼游过，没有谁低头看我。
lines.en: A school of fish passes, and none looks down.

lines.zh: 身上的铁色在暗处也发闷光。
lines.en: Even in the dark, my iron tint gives a dull shine.

lines.zh: 什么都不做的时候，我贴得最稳。
lines.en: When I do nothing at all, I hold on best.

lines.zh: 我把壳往岩缝里挤了挤。
lines.en: I wedge my shell a little deeper into the crack.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼啄我的壳，我忍着。
lines.en: A small fish pecks my shell. I let it.

lines.zh: 你潜得这么深，就为了看我？
lines.en: You came down this deep just to look at me?

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，水一下变凉。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and the water cools.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只能看到你靴子的底。
lines.en: I look up and see only the sole of your boot.

lines.zh: 别用手碰，我的鳞片边缘很薄。
lines.en: Do not touch me; my scale edges are thin.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的气泡撞在喷口上碎了。
lines.en: Your breath bubbles break apart against the vent.

lines.zh: 我认得这双眼睛，上次你也来了。
lines.en: I know those eyes; you came down before.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，热水都让你挡没了。
lines.en: You stand too close and block my warm water.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的铁镐，看了好一会。
lines.en: I stare at the iron pick at your belt a while.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，看谁先走。
lines.en: You hold still; so do I. Who leaves first?

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，我的触角缩了回去。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright; my feelers pull back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把壳对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and point my shell at you.

lines.zh: 你脚下的沙扬起来，落了我一身。
lines.en: Sand kicks up from your feet and settles on me.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我疼得缩紧。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell and I clench.

lines.zh: 那一下让我滑离了岩面。
lines.en: That blow knocked me off the rock face.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了几片，水一下变凉。
lines.en: A few scales came off and the water feels colder.

lines.zh: 疼，可我贴着的这块石头没松。
lines.en: It hurts, but I have not let go of this stone.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，等疼劲过去。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and wait out the pain.

lines.zh: 血一样的锈色在水里散开。
lines.en: A rust-colored stain spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 我挪不动了，只能先贴着。
lines.en: I cannot move, so I just hold on.

lines.zh: 这一下打在鳞足上，最要命。
lines.en: This hit landed on my scaled foot, the worst place.

lines.zh: 我尽力缩成一粒小石头。
lines.en: I try to shrink into a small, plain stone.

lines.zh: 疼得我触角都收不回去。
lines.en: It hurts so much my feelers will not retract.

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁，闻着像我的壳。
lines.en: The iron in your hand smells like my shell.

lines.zh: 是热的石头吗？我往那边挪了一寸。
lines.en: Is that warm stone? I shift an inch toward it.

lines.zh: 那股硫味一飘过来，我就走不动了。
lines.en: That sulfur smell drifts over and my feet stop.

lines.zh: 你放下的碎铁在水底发暗光。
lines.en: The scrap you set down glows faintly on the floor.

lines.zh: 我伸出触角，先探探水温。
lines.en: I reach out a feeler to test the water first.

lines.zh: 这块矿物壳上有我喜欢的锈色。
lines.en: This mineral crust has the rust color I like.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬过去，不是为了你。
lines.en: I crawl over slowly, and not because of you.

lines.zh: 你把铁块贴近水底，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: You bring the iron near the floor and I look up.

lines.zh: 热的、带铁味的、还会动的，真好。
lines.en: Warm, iron-scented, and moving: that is good.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，先舔了一口。
lines.en: I circle it once, then lick the surface.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才敢再靠近半寸。
lines.en: You step back; only then do I close half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的鳞足自己就往那边伸了。
lines.en: My scaled foot reaches out before I decide.

lines.zh: 那东西要是掉的，我就不客气了。
lines.en: If you drop that, I will not be polite.

lines.zh: 别收走，我爬得慢，追不上你的手。
lines.en: Do not take it back; I crawl too slowly to chase.

lines.zh: 你手里那块锈铁，我盯了很久。
lines.en: I've watched that rusty iron in your hand a while.

lines.zh: 水底那股铁味，让我挪了半寸。
lines.en: That iron taste in the water moves me half an inch.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我的壳磕在石头上。
lines.en: You kicked me and my shell knocked the stone.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我贴得比你想的牢。
lines.en: A bump is fine; I hold tighter than you think.

lines.zh: 我缩进去了，等你走开再出来。
lines.en: I pull in and wait for you to move on.

lines.zh: 你的靴底擦过我的鳞，掉了两片。
lines.en: Your sole scraped my scales and two came loose.

lines.zh: 别把我当石子踢，我会黏在你脚上。
lines.en: Do not kick me like a pebble; I will stick.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滑开，又慢慢爬回原位。
lines.en: I slide from the hit and crawl back to my spot.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我一时找不到岩缝。
lines.en: The water muddies and I lose the crevice.

lines.zh: 你退半步吧，我这儿实在没地方让。
lines.en: Step back a little; there is no room to yield.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，可我的壳薄，会裂。
lines.en: The knock was light, but my shell is thin.

lines.zh: 我贴回岩面，把撞歪的身体摆正。
lines.en: I press back to the rock and straighten myself.

lines.zh: 另一只鳞足螺贴在我旁边。
lines.en: Another scalyfoot presses close beside me.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着，鳞片轻轻相碰。
lines.en: We cling side by side, scale touching scale.

lines.zh: 它爬得比我还慢，我等等它。
lines.en: It crawls slower than I do, so I wait.

lines.zh: 两只一起挪，留下的痕也成了两条。
lines.en: Two of us move, and the trail becomes two lines.

lines.zh: 它把铁色的壳歪过来，我也歪过去。
lines.en: It tilts its iron-colored shell; I tilt mine.

lines.zh: 喷口的热水够两只分，不用争。
lines.en: The vent's warmth is enough for two, no need to fight.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰它的触角，它没有缩。
lines.en: I touch its feeler and it does not pull away.

lines.zh: 我们贴在同一块岩上，谁也没动。
lines.en: We hold the same stone and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 它的鳞比我的亮，大概铁吃得多。
lines.en: Its scales shine more; it must eat more iron.

lines.zh: 等小的一批孵出来，会挤满这条缝。
lines.en: When the small ones hatch, this crack will be crowded.

lines.zh: 地上这颗小铁粒，我收下了。
lines.en: This little iron nugget on the floor is mine now.

lines.zh: 我用触角卷住它，慢慢塞到身下。
lines.en: I curl a feeler around it and tuck it beneath me.

lines.zh: 这块碎壳不错，能垫在底下。
lines.en: This shell chip is good; it can prop me up.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，但从不丢。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly, but I never drop them.

lines.zh: 有东西落在喷口边，我爬过去看看。
lines.en: Something fell by the vent; I crawl over to look.

lines.zh: 这粒矿物够我啃上一阵。
lines.en: This grain of mineral will keep me busy a while.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，谁也拿不走。
lines.en: I press it under my body where none can take it.

lines.zh: 是谁掉的铁屑？现在归我了。
lines.en: Whose iron filings are these? They are mine now.

lines.zh: 我抱着一小片锈石，继续往前挪。
lines.en: I carry a rust flake and keep creeping forward.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西越沉，我爬得越稳。
lines.en: The heavier what I carry, the steadier my crawl.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我先把身体压低。
lines.en: Something moves, so I flatten myself first.

lines.zh: 那影子太大了，我盯住它。
lines.en: That shadow is too big; I keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 我转向动静那侧，鳞足抓紧了。
lines.en: I turn toward the noise and grip with my foot.

lines.zh: 不是食物，但我还是看着。
lines.en: It is not food, but I watch it anyway.

lines.zh: 它靠近了，我缩到壳里去。
lines.en: It comes closer, so I withdraw into my shell.

lines.zh: 我锁定那块晃动的暗影。
lines.en: I fix on that wavering dark shape.

lines.zh: 触角先伸出去，替我看清。
lines.en: My feelers go out first to see for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到岩缝背风的一侧。
lines.en: I creep to the sheltered side of the crevice.

lines.zh: 那东西没再动，我放松了一点。
lines.en: It stops moving, and I ease off a little.

lines.zh: 我记住了这个位置，下次绕开。
lines.en: I remember this spot and will go around next time.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，一秒都没移开。
lines.en: I stare at it and do not look away.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的触角就跟着转。
lines.en: When it moves, my feelers turn to follow.

lines.zh: 我的壳对着它，这是我能做的。
lines.en: My shell faces it; that is all I can do.

lines.zh: 距离太远，我只能一直看。
lines.en: It is too far, so I can only keep watching.

lines.zh: 它绕到左边，我慢慢转过去。
lines.en: It circles left, and I turn slowly after it.

lines.zh: 热水挡了眼，我还是没松。
lines.en: The vent water blinds me, but I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，等它先动。
lines.en: I lower myself and wait for it to move first.

lines.zh: 这是我唯一能做的防守。
lines.en: This is the only defense I have.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我也停住。
lines.en: It stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我盯得久了，眼睛有点酸。
lines.en: I have stared so long my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我用齿舌刮它一下，就这样。
lines.en: I scrape it once with my radula, and that is all.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够磨石头。
lines.en: My strength is only enough to grind stone.

lines.zh: 咬不动，我就换成推。
lines.en: I cannot bite it, so I push instead.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，你别指望更多。
lines.en: This blow is light; do not expect more.

lines.zh: 鳞足蹬了一下，它退开半步。
lines.en: My scaled foot shoves, and it gives half a step.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，自己先翻了。
lines.en: I lunge, and I am the one who tips over.

lines.zh: 齿舌刮过，留下浅浅一道白印。
lines.en: My radula passes, leaving a pale shallow line.

lines.zh: 我不想打，可它踩到我了。
lines.en: I do not want to fight, but it stepped on me.

lines.zh: 力气小，位置却挑得准。
lines.en: Little strength, but I pick the spot well.

lines.zh: 一下之后，我立刻缩回去。
lines.en: After one hit, I pull straight back in.

lines.zh: 我在喷口的黑烟里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes inside the vent's black smoke.

lines.zh: 热水把我从岩缝里冲出来。
lines.en: Hot water flushes me out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 一落地，我就贴住了石头。
lines.en: The moment I land, I stick to the stone.

lines.zh: 旁边还有一只，和我差不多大。
lines.en: Another one is beside me, about my size.

lines.zh: 我出生在热液喷口的边上。
lines.en: I was born at the edge of a hydrothermal vent.

lines.zh: 这里很暗，但水是暖的。
lines.en: It is dark here, but the water is warm.

lines.zh: 我先把鳞足伸开，试试岩面。
lines.en: I spread my scaled foot first to test the rock.

lines.zh: 头一件事，是找块能贴的岩壁。
lines.en: First thing: find a wall I can cling to.

lines.zh: 硫味呛得我缩了一下。
lines.en: The sulfur stings and I flinch once.

lines.zh: 我从一小片铁色的卵里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a small clutch of iron-colored eggs.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧不起来，只是烫。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn down here; it only scalds.

lines.zh: 从岩壁掉下去，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I fell from the wall and my shell struck stone.

lines.zh: 我在水里出生，可还是会被闷住。
lines.en: I was born in water, yet I can still smother.

lines.zh: 冲击把喷口都震塌了一角。
lines.en: The blast knocked a corner off the vent.

lines.zh: 有东西射进水里，扎穿了我的壳。
lines.en: Something shot through the water and pierced my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕过壳，直接捏住我。
lines.en: That force slipped past my shell and squeezed me.

lines.zh: 铁味太淡，我已经饿了几顿。
lines.en: The iron taste is thin; I have missed several meals.

lines.zh: 白光穿过海水，我的鳞全立起来。
lines.en: White light pierces the sea and all my scales rise.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的鳞足抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No water here; my scaled foot grips nothing at all.
